name: vc-test
description: PREVIEW — one testing flow for a Virto Commerce ticket: /vc-test:ticket-context → change map → scored scenarios approved at one human point → one agent per scenario plus a background AC run → triage → Medium-only investigation → verdict, with tokens and minutes per step. /vc-test:init declares which environments a run may write to and the project's knowledge store. Ships /vc-test:ticket-context and /vc-test:qa-test-strategy with their agents (ticket-context-analyst, strategy-verifier); /vc-test:ticket-context reads Jira or Azure Boards and GitHub or Azure Repos only through $VC_RUN, holding no token. Triage, investigation and some context scripts of /vc-test:qa-ticket still need an ai-tools checkout until P1d-3. Depends on vc-init (profile, $VC_RUN, the script runner) and vc-fix.
